messages:
Tara Patel: hey folks — first day in product here 👋. Can someone point me to the canonical places for: (1) Figma team access, (2) product roadmap Notion, and (3) the user-research interview repo? Also who should I ping for quick onboarding questions?

Lucas Kim: welcome Tara!! :tada: I own Figma invites for the product team. DM me your work email and I’ll add you to the ‘Product / Design’ team.

Tara Patel: thanks Lucas — sent DM. also curious about permissions: can PMs get comment-only vs editor by default?

Lucas Kim: default is editor for full-time PD, comment-only for contractors. If you need editor temporarily, say so in the DM and I’ll set it.

Aisha Gomez: adding research bits — the interview transcripts + synthesis live in Notion under "Research > Team Repository". You’ll need Notion group access (product-viewer) — @Rachel (design-ops) handles that.

Rachel (design-ops): hi Tara! I can give you Notion access. Quick process: 1) confirm your work email here, 2) fill tiny access form (link below). I’ll usually grant product-viewer within an hour.

Rachel (design-ops): Access form: https://notion.redwood.com/access-requests (pick "product" then "research repo" and add a short reason)

devex-bot: Tip: you can also run `/request-access Figma` in #devex and it will open a ticket for design-ops.

Maya (Research): hi Tara — welcome! For the research repo: we keep recordings in the Research Drive and transcripts + highlights in Notion (see Aisha's path). If you need past interview notes, say which area (onboarding, billing, integrations) and I’ll share a short reading pack.

Tara Patel: appreciate it. Could someone share the product roadmap link? I want to skim priorities before sync later.

Aisha Gomez: product roadmap is in Notion: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap — you’ll see a read-only roadmap board once Rachel grants access. If you want edit rights for planning, ping me and I’ll propose a spot on the next planning doc.

Lucas Kim: Figma note: if you plan to edit design files, enable the latest Figma plugin permissions (we use the "Redwood Components" team library). After I add you, open the file and click `Assets > Team Libraries` to enable.

Maya (Research): mini checklist for your first week re: research: 1) skim 3 most recent interview synths (I’ll add links), 2) join the weekly research sync (Weds 10am PT), 3) shadow a usability session (I’ll invite you to one). Want me to drop the synth links here now?

Tara Patel: yes please that'd be super helpful 🙏

Maya (Research): done — added three synth links in the thread and invited you to the research sync. Also dropped a small onboarding pack in Notion with sample interview scripts and consent language.

Rachel (design-ops): all set — Notion invite sent to tara@redwood.com, and Lucas added you to Figma as editor. If you hit any permission walls, @design-ops is the fastest route.

Tara Patel: got both invites, thanks everyone! One last quick Q: who owns the roadmap cadence notes (meeting minutes)?

Aisha Gomez: I capture the high-level decisions; product PMs keep the meeting minutes in the roadmap page under "Cadence notes". If you want, I’ll share the last three meeting minutes with you.

Tara Patel: yes please — that would be great. Thanks again for the quick help :blush:
